author: Hermes subagent (deepseek-v4-flash)
purpose: Single authority registry for the Universal Garment Creation System. Unifies every existing garment / cymatic / water-veil / cloth-tier / PCG-placement work so no future lane forks a parallel garment system. Authority doc: Docs/Art/UNIVERSAL_GARMENT_SYSTEM_MASTER_SPEC_2026-09-02.md

chain.flow: 48 Shorewake panels packed into one slotted dress mesh (SW_Dress_P01..P48)
per garment piece -> cloth-tier A/B/C/D (cost ladder)
per layer/zone Chladni PBR 9-map + animated flipbook + singing-water zone maps
one MI per garment layer on the VERIFIED small master family
height-aware placement on CanonicalLandscape, PCGEx measured-curve splines (no new landscape, no scatter dump)
Houdini Vellum / FLIP drape + imported sheet seam; single MPC writer untouched

masters_forbidden: any new master beyond the small family

stages.definition_of_done: SM_ShorewakeDress_48MAT_v2_slotted.obj packs all 48 panels as one addressable dress mesh with per-panel SW_Dress_PNN geometry spans (z_lo/z_hi/zsp, rmean/rmax, w/d, azimuth). Source manifest hashed, deterministic seed 20260902.

stages.definition_of_done: silhouette_garment_label.py classifies all 48 panels into exactly 10 garment-layer material groups; every panel assigned; merged set stable and seed-locked; no two layers identical.

vocab_contract.mode_range_note: m,n integer pair. <=8 so nodal lines stay crisp at 2K; >=1 so they read as a woven motif. Bass->treble maps via m=round(sqrt(f/220)*3), n=round(sqrt(f/220)*5).
vocab_contract.sing: A bound sing = {domain, piece, chladni:[m,n], read_as} — the single atomic harmonic unit shared by garment layers, water zones, and drapery tiers.

domains.garment_layer: 10 dead-silhouette garment layers; each carries exactly one (m,n)
domains.water_zone: 4 singing-water zones (singing-water-veil); each carries exactly one (m,n)
domains.drapery_tier: A/B/C/D cost class, orthogonal to mode (a piece's tier and mode are independent contracts)
domains.veil: hero opaque/sheet surfaces (Klein Veil, RoseWindow, SheetVeil) — drape seam candidates, tier-B or C

cloth_tiers.A: Rigid authored (structured lace, ornaments, columns, caps) — cheapest, deterministic
cloth_tiers.B: Chaos/Cloth collision — hero sheets carrying gameplay meaning (Skirt_Full, HeartGate finial, RoseWindow lace). Expensive.
cloth_tiers.C: WPO (MF_FabricMountainWPO wind + cymatic micro-swell) — cheap dynamic, km terrain + distant drape
cloth_tiers.D: VAT/cache authored bake — impossible-emergent contraction (terrain) via Houdini bake, never runtime sim

vocab_contract.tex_contract: T_<Domain>_<Piece>_<Channel>.png where Domain in {Cymatic_Garment, SingingWater, Shorewake_Garment, KleinVeil}, Channel in {BaseColor,Normal,Height,Roughness,Metallic,Iridescence,Emissive,ORM,Opacity}
vocab_contract.mi_naming: MI_Melusina_<Family>_Cymatic_<Layer> parented to M_Master_Nikki | M_Universal_Enhanced_Fabric | M_Master_Toon_Universal_Alpha by cloth tier (masked->Toon_Alpha, satin->Nikki, hero sheet->Enhanced_Fabric)
vocab_contract.gameplay_tag_root: Melodia.Sing.Garment.<Layer> / Melodia.Sing.Water.<Zone> / Melodia.Sing.Veil.<Piece> — FGameplayTag naming shared across cymatics, water zones, and drapery tiers
vocab_contract.mpc_writer_contract: Single writer UMelodiaAudioReactivePresentationSubsystem -> MPC_Melodia_Palette (BeatPulse/BassIntensity/BeatIntensity/BeatPhase/BeatTracker). Every garment/water/veil consumer is READ-ONLY via UMelodiaCymaticsSubsystem. Never add a second audio writer.
rules: One (m,n) per singable surface; no shared vocabulary key differs by presentation layer
No two co-singing pieces within a level share the same (m,n) — if two pieces co-present, modes must differ (the dress reads as one instrument)
Adjacent garment layers must differ in mode
Garment piece carrying gameplay meaning gets the expensive cloth tier (B), supporting pieces cheap (C/A)
No new master beyond the verified small family
Height-aware placement on CanonicalLandscape; never a new landscape
Runtime drape only where fidelity matters (B); km terrain = WPO/D, never runtime sim

gaps.title: Everything is offline-manifest-only; nothing is live in the editor
gaps.detail: S4 MI cook/import and S5 live PCG ground-snap are 100% editor-gated. 0/7 height-aware hits are offline_synthetic (TraceChannel int-vs-enum bug + empty landscape); all placements invalid on future landscape import. Until MIs are created on the verified family and PCG grounds to CanonicalLandscape, the 'system' is manifests, not garments.

gaps.title: Shared harmonic vocabulary is not enforced across domains (mode collisions)
gaps.detail: 3 of 4 singing-water zones already collide with garment layers (SingingFall(5,7)=Bodice_Torso, HearthPool(1,3)=Bodice_Upper, TideSeam(6,6)=Collar). No validate gate asserts 'no two co-singing pieces share (m,n)' across the registry. A future lane can still introduce a parallel harmonic or reuse a mode silently. universal_garment_system.json is the registry; the vocab gate must score it.
